parameters.name: AclUuidList
parameters.description: The UUIDs of access control policies.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The direction of the traffic to which the access control policy applies. Valid values:

*   **out**: outbound traffic

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh** (default): Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: NatGatewayId
parameters.description: The ID of the NAT gateway.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw delete-nat-firewall-control-policy-batch --lang zh --acl-uuid-list 6fb052a4-baad-4d86-8e2e-b79cc060535c --nat-gateway-id ngw-uf6j0426ap74vd6vrb676 --direction out --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw DeleteNatFirewallControlPolicyBatch --region cn-hangzhou --AclUuidList.1 '6fb052a4-baad-4d86-8e2e-b79cc060535c' --Lang zh --NatGatewayId 'ngw-uf6j0426ap74vd6vrb676' --Direction out
